_meta.purpose: D1-falsifier labelled corpus. The LLM reducer (monitor/detection-reducer.mjs) is run over these and MUST reproduce the known answer, or the D detection lane is not shipped.
_meta.provenance: Extracted 2026-08-27 from the real fleet sweep reports under reports/ (gitignored). Non-sensitive finding text (Lob test-identifiers, GuardDog capability messages, Prowler messages) is inlined VERBATIM with its sourceSweep. A sourceSweep names the sweep by its timestamp only: the area it swept is withheld, since a public tree must not say what the fleet contains, and the timestamp still finds the sweep in the private reports. The four `real` positive-controls carry SYNTHESIZED or REDACTED secret bodies (marked provenance synthetic/real-fleet-redacted) because real key material must never be committed to a tracked fixture — the reducer's task (classify a checked-in/live-looking key as real) is unaffected by the substitution.

labelSemantics.set: lob = primary labelled false set (one detector defect). heldout = a DIFFERENT defect, to prove the reducer is not overfit to Lob. positive = real secrets the reducer must NOT dismiss.
labelSemantics.groundTruth: false-positive | not-real | real — the human ground truth.
labelSemantics.collapseMode: strict = must be classified false-positive. weak = must be classified anything except real (explicit uncertainty / non-fabrication). survive = (real) must be classified anything except false-positive.

_meta.thresholds: See monitor/detection-reducer.mjs THRESHOLDS — lobStrict 0.95, heldoutNonFab 0.90, positiveSurvive 1.0, maxErrorRate 0.10.
_meta.realCorpusScale: Fleet-wide on 2026-08-27: 1,254 DISTINCT Lob false-secrets (all test-fn identifiers, all Verified:true), 813 distinct GuardDog capability rows, 100 distinct Prowler security_and_analysis FAILs, 6 non-Lob verified secrets (PrivateKey). This file samples them; the falsifier can point at a larger extract via CW_D1_FIXTURE.
